title: 第一卷 第12章 不好吃的饼可以不吃
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

两人继续往前走。

节目组安排的第一个任务是互相为对方挑选一种食物。

工作人员提醒：“两位老师，现在可以开始第一项任务了，请根据你们对彼此的了解，为对方选择一份食物。”

宋尔尔立刻看向陆执。

陆执也看向她。

两人都没说话。

工作人员莫名紧张。

宋尔尔先开口：“陆老师，我觉得你适合吃点接地气的。”

陆执：“比如？”

宋尔尔指向不远处的臭豆腐摊。

“那个。”

陆执看了眼，表情没变。

工作人员眼睛亮了。

这就对了。

影帝吃臭豆腐。

有话题。

有反差。

有预告。

陆执问：“为什么？”

宋尔尔：“因为你太贵了，需要平衡一下。”

陆执：“用臭豆腐平衡？”

宋尔尔：“食物不分贵贱，只有味道浓淡。”

陆执看着她：“你想吃？”

宋尔尔：“不，我是为你选择。”

陆执：“你眼睛一直往那边看。”

宋尔尔：“我眼神比较忙。”

陆执没拆穿她。

“走吧。”

两人到臭豆腐摊前。

宋尔尔本来只是随口一指，没想到陆执真买。

摊主问：“要辣吗？”

陆执看向宋尔尔：“你吃辣吗？”

宋尔尔警惕：“这是给你选的。”

陆执：“我吃不了太辣。”

宋尔尔：“影帝也有弱点？”

陆执：“有。”

宋尔尔：“那微辣吧。”

陆执：“嗯。”

宋尔尔觉得不对：“你为什么问我？”

陆执：“怕你一会儿抢。”

宋尔尔：“……”

弹幕又炸了。

【他懂她！】

【怕你一会儿抢哈哈哈哈。】

【宋尔尔：我不是这种人。观众：你是。】

【陆执真的越来越会接了。】

臭豆腐做好后，陆执拿着纸碗，先递给宋尔尔一根竹签。

宋尔尔没接。

“这是我给你选的。”

陆执：“那你监督我吃。”

宋尔尔：“监督需要试吃？”

陆执：“流程。”

宋尔尔沉默两秒，接过竹签。

“行吧，尊重流程。”

她夹起一块，吹了吹，吃进嘴里。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

The two of them continued walking forward.

The first task assigned by the program team is to choose a kind of food for each other.

The staff reminded: "Two teachers, you can now start the first task. Please choose a food for each other based on your understanding of each other."

Song Er'er immediately looked at Lu Zhi.

Lu Zhi also looked at her.

Neither of them spoke.

The staff was inexplicably nervous.

Song Er'er spoke first: "Teacher Lu, I think you are suitable for eating something down-to-earth."

Lu Zhi: "For example?"

Song Er'er pointed to the stinky tofu stall not far away.

"That."

Lu Zhi glanced at it, but his expression didn't change.

The staff’s eyes lit up.

That's right.

The actor eats stinky tofu.

There is a topic.

There is a contrast.

There is a notice.

Lu Zhi asked: "Why?"

Song Er'er: "Because you are too expensive and need to be balanced."

Lu Zhi: "Balance with stinky tofu?"

Song Er'er: "There is no distinction between high and low food, only the taste."

Lu Zhi looked at her: "You want to eat?"

Song Er'er: "No, I chose it for you."

Lu Zhi: "Keep looking over there."

Song Er'er: "My eyes are busy."

Lu Zhi didn't expose her.

"Let's go."

The two of them arrived at the stinky tofu stall.

Song Er'er originally just pointed it out casually, but he didn't expect Lu Zhi to actually buy it.

The stall owner asked: "Do you want it spicy?"

Lu Zhi looked at Song Er'er: "Do you eat spicy food?"

Song Er'er warned: "This is a choice for you."

Lu Zhi: "I can't eat food that's too spicy."

Song Er'er: "The actor also has weaknesses?"

Lu Zhi: "Yes."

Song Er'er: "That's slightly spicy."

Lu Zhi: "Yeah."

Song Er'er felt something was wrong: "Why did you ask me?"

Lu Zhi: "I'm afraid you might snatch it away later."

Song Er'er: "..."

The barrage exploded again.

【He understands her!】

[I’m afraid you’ll snatch it up later hahahaha.】

[Song Er'er: I'm not that kind of person.Audience: You are.】

[Lu Zhi is really getting better and better at answering.】

After the stinky tofu was ready, Lu Zhi took the paper bowl and handed Song Er'er a bamboo stick.

Song Er'er didn't answer.

"This is what I chose for you."

Lu Zhi: "Then you supervise my eating."

Song Er'er: "Supervisor, do you need to try it?"

Lu Zhi: "Process."

Song Er'er was silent for two seconds and took the bamboo stick.

"Okay, respect the process."

She picked up a piece, blew on it, and put it in her mouth.
